# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Bonds.

The canonical contributor guide lives in the Bonds documentation:

- [Contributor overview](https://bonds.fyi/latest/contributing/)
- [Development workflow](https://bonds.fyi/latest/contributing/development/)
- [Testing](https://bonds.fyi/latest/contributing/testing/)
- [Pull requests](https://bonds.fyi/latest/contributing/pull-requests/)
- [Reporting issues](https://bonds.fyi/latest/contributing/issues/)

Related guideline resources:

- [Security Policy](https://bonds.fyi/latest/resources/security/)
- [Code of Conduct](https://bonds.fyi/latest/resources/code-of-conduct/)
- [License](https://bonds.fyi/latest/resources/license/)

If those docs have not been published yet, the source files live in:

- `docs/content/contributing/index.md`
- `docs/content/contributing/development.md`
- `docs/content/contributing/testing.md`
- `docs/content/contributing/pull-requests.md`
- `docs/content/contributing/issues.md`

## Quick checklist

Before opening a pull request:

- keep shared behavior in `crates/core`
- add or update tests for behavior changes
- update docs when commands, APIs, or user workflows change
- run `make pre-commit` and any relevant app/docs checks

Thank you for helping improve Bonds.
